scope: Public-source observations; no installed geometry claim

sources.author: Ford dealer catalog reproduction
sources.derived_observations: The selected 1994 F-150 XL 4.9L catalog illustrates a twin-outlet lid, paired ducts, a separate fresh-air inlet and a formed support (item 2). The support has raised walls and mounting tabs; it is not a flat shelf. F4TZ-9600-C is listed for the federal 4.9L configuration. The owner’s emissions calibration remains unknown. No dimensioned support drawing or body mounting coordinates are supplied.

sources.author: Heavy Metal Vintage
sources.derived_observations: Photos 4, 6 and 12 show two unequal ducts joined by a web, localized corrugations near the large cuffs, long smooth narrow ends, four worm-drive clamps and an external open retainer. Moldings identify E7TE-9R504-AF and individual E7TE-9B659-AF/BF tubes. The seller describes 4.9L use; its broad fitment table is not application proof. A visible tape supports only a coarse projected span: about 22 ± 2 inches for the longer tube and 21 ± 2 inches for the shorter. Perspective, off-plane ruler and free-state flex prevent interpreting these as installed reach or centerline length.

sources.author: waffledeals
sources.derived_observations: Photos 1 and 5 show the large duct cuffs on the twin-outlet lid, a separate flattened fresh-air inlet and a formed metal support around the lower box. Two opposing attachment points visibly include rubber-like isolators and cup/washer/bolt stacks. Their detailed construction and dimensions remain unverified. The seller identifies a 1992–1996 F-150 4.9L assembly and lists F3TE-9A675-BB and E7TE-9643-CA; these are specimen claims, not proof of the owner’s exact parts. The listing’s generic package/part dimensions are unusable as mounting datums.
